howToUse.heroTitle: How to Create a Custom QR Code — Complete Guide
howToUse.heroSub: Learn how to create, design, customize, and download free QR codes with logos, frames, and custom colors in 5 simple steps.

steps.title: Choose Your Content Type
steps.description: Select from 12 content types: URL, Plain Text, WiFi credentials, vCard contact, Email, SMS, Phone, App Store link, Event (iCal), Crypto wallet, or batch CSV upload.
steps.hint: Tip: Use vCard to create a scannable digital business card instantly.

steps.title: Design Your QR Style
steps.description: Choose from 39 dot patterns (squares, circles, rounded, fluid, leaves, diamonds, and more), 28 eye frame shapes, and matching eyeball styles.
steps.hint: Tip: Use rounded or circular dots for a modern, premium feel.

steps.title: Add Your Logo
steps.description: Upload a custom PNG/JPG/SVG logo or pick from 46 preset brand icons. Set logo size, padding color, and shape (square or circle).
steps.hint: Tip: Use a white or matching background pad around dark logos.

steps.title: Apply Frames & Effects
steps.description: Wrap your QR code in one of 51 text frames with custom label text and fonts. Add shadow effects, rounded corners, and background images.
steps.hint: Tip: A simple bold frame with your website URL boosts engagement.

steps.title: Download & Share
steps.description: Export in PNG (up to 8K resolution), SVG (infinite vector scale), or PDF (print-ready). Batch mode exports all codes as a ZIP.
steps.hint: Tip: Use SVG for print materials — scales to any size perfectly.

footer.desc: Create stunning, fully customizable QR codes with logo embedding. 100% free, no signup required, no expiration limits.
